abilities.effect: Ephemeral energies pour from the creature's head, and the creature must attempt a DC 30 Will save.
abilities.failure: The creature is stupefied 2 for 1 hour and loses 1 minute of recent memories (a memory of the GM's choosing within the last 24 hours).
abilities.name: Drink Thoughts
abilities.success: The creature is stupefied 1 for 1 minute.
abilities.trigger: A creature looks into the pit

hazard.description: Anyone looking into the hole has memories sucked from their head.
hazard.disable: DC 29 Deception (master) to feed the pit false thoughts that plug it, or DC 28 Occultism (expert) or *dispel magic* (4th level; counteract DC 27) to drain the pit's magic
hazard.name: Memory Hole
hazard.reset: The trap resets after 1 hour if it's not disabled.

traits.name: Magical
traits.text: Something with the magical trait is imbued with magical energies not tied to a specific tradition of magic. Some items or effects are closely tied to a particular tradition of magic. In these cases, the item has the arcane, divine, occult, or primal trait instead of the magical trait. Any of these traits indicate that the item is magical.

traits.name: Trap
traits.text: A hazard constructed to hinder interlopers.
